input: # Each statement is known by the alternative its dispatch rule pushes, which
# proto-grammar/*.abnf's alternative order fixes; alchemy/transduce.alc reads
# the passes by these names, so a grammar that renumbers them fails here.
message M { enum E {} message N {} option a = 1; oneof o {} map<a, b> m = 1; extend E {} extensions 1; reserved 1; ; export message P {} local enum F {} group G = 1 {} int32 f = 2 [a = 1]; }
enum E { option a = 1; reserved 1; ; A = 0; }
message M { oneof o { option a = 1; ; group G = 1 {} int32 f = 2; } }
service S { option a = 1; ; rpc R (M) returns (M) { option a = 1; } }
